name: Mauricio Ramírez L.
headline: .NET Software Engineer | C# / .NET Core Development | CI/CD Pipelines | SQL Server | Web Application Modernization
summary: Back-End Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining .NET applications for finance and retail. Proven track record building secure web applications and RESTful APIs with C#/.NET Core and SQL Server, implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Jenkins, and improving system reliability, scalability, and deployment efficiency in production environments.

bullets: Designed and developed 10+ scalable microservices using .NET Framework and .NET Core, supporting inventory forecasting systems processing millions of records daily for global retail operations.
Built and optimized secure RESTful APIs in C#/.NET, reducing average response time by 25–35% through improved error handling, caching, and versioning strategies.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins, decreasing deployment time by 40% and enabling multiple weekly releases with a >95% deployment success rate.
Enforced code quality practices including unit testing and SonarQube static code analysis, reducing production defects by 30% and improving overall application maintainability.
Partnered with product and planning teams to deliver backend solutions that improved forecast accuracy and reduced stock discrepancies across global operations.
Contributed to high-volume backend systems processing scalable inventory data and enabling real-time decision-making for an enterprise environment.
Developed microservices in .NET and Java for financial transaction systems handling high-volume digital credit operations with strict security and reliability requirements.
Implemented asynchronous processing and system integrations, improving system throughput by 30% and reducing latency in transaction flows.
Centralized business rules and automated decision logic, reducing manual intervention and accelerating credit approval processes by 20–25%.
Participated in system design using fault-tolerant patterns, improving system resilience and reducing service downtime.
Delivered backend services powering production digital credit and mobile wallet platforms where operational stability and auditability were critical.
Eliminated operational bottlenecks by automating processing logic, improving efficiency and consistency across transaction workflows.
Developed backend APIs and web applications using .NET Core and SQL Server, supporting business operations with improved data accessibility and system performance.
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, reducing reporting execution time by 30–40% and enhancing data retrieval efficiency.
Built reporting dashboards that enabled stakeholders to make faster, data-driven decisions, reducing reporting turnaround time from days to hours.
Maintained and enhanced internal HR and finance systems, improving system reliability and reducing support incidents by 20%.
Developed reporting tools that streamlined administrative workflows, saving dozens of manual hours per month.
Collaborated with stakeholders to implement system improvements aligned with operational needs.
